description: This file defines configuration schemas, validation, and normalization functions for a voice call plugin, including provider-specific settings, webhook security, tunnel, streaming, and realtime configurations, as well as utility functions for handling environment variables and configuration merging.

methods.name: cloneDefaultVoiceCallConfig
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the default voice call configuration.

methods.name: normalizeWebhookLikePath
methods.description: Normalizes webhook URL paths to ensure they start with '/' and do not end with '/'.

methods.name: defaultRealtimeStreamPathForServePath
methods.description: Generates default WebSocket stream path based on the serve path.

methods.name: normalizeVoiceCallTtsConfig
methods.description: Deep merges and normalizes TTS configuration overrides.

methods.name: sanitizeVoiceCallProviderConfigs
methods.description: Filters out undefined provider configurations from a record.

methods.name: normalizeVoiceCallConfig
methods.description: Merges user input with default configuration, normalizing paths and provider configs.

methods.name: resolveVoiceCallConfig
methods.description: Merges environment variables into configuration fields, normalizing the final configuration.

methods.name: validateProviderConfig
methods.description: Validates that the configuration has all required fields based on the selected provider and settings.
